name: memex-cloud
description: Memex as a remote MCP server on Cloudflare: a searchable mirror of your vault plus an inbox for memos written by remote agents.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/setup-vectorize.mjs && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: The password you type when an MCP client (claude.ai, Claude Code, ...) asks you to sign in. Use a long random string and keep it in a password manager.

SYNC_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the `memex cloud push` / `memex cloud pull` CLI. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

CONSENT_SECRET.description: Signing key (32+ characters) for remembered sign-ins. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional, and not asked for by the Deploy button. Add it afterwards under Settings > Variables and Secrets to turn on semantic search (it embeds queries with the model your vectors came from). Without it, search is keyword-only.

DB.description: Documents, chunks, observations and the inbox (D1, with FTS5 keyword search).

VECTORIZE.description: Chunk and observation vectors for semantic search. When asked, enter **Dimensions: 768** and **Metric: cosine** (they must match the vectors `memex cloud push` sends).
